curve.equation: y^2 = x^3 + a x + b over F_p
curve.point_counting_method: Euler criterion over every x in F_p (curve.count_points), vectorised

stats.note_rho: RHO hits are collisions among a target's own walks Q_u + [c]P; such a collision yields (c + s - c' - s') P = O and no logarithm, so RHO emits no certificate on the curve
